title: Whether mental actions exist is left open

statements.text: The question whether there are mental actions at all is not answered. There is so far no satisfying account of mental action under predictive processing, and the choice lies between a realist option, which owes a multi-level theory of goal selection and action initiation, and an eliminativist option, which owes successor concepts and an account of why inner life has been described so falsely.

sources.quote: Are there mental actions at all? I will not answer this question here.
there is no satisfying theoretical account of mental action under the PP approach
